description: Current-value operational projections backed by canonical v1 Parquet. PostgreSQL holds replaceable latest snapshots only; historical research remains in DuckDB.

panels.description: Coverage is configured active securities for enabled Yahoo plus one enabled-FRED source unit. PostgreSQL does not currently persist the configured FRED series list, so per-series expected coverage is not claimed.

targets.rawSql: WITH enabled AS (SELECT bool_or(code = 'yahoo' AND enabled) AS yahoo, bool_or(code = 'fred' AND enabled) AS fred FROM data_sources WHERE code IN ('yahoo', 'fred')), counts AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN enabled.yahoo THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM securities WHERE active_until IS NULL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN enabled.fred THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS expected, (CASE WHEN enabled.yahoo THEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.id) FROM securities s JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.code = 'yahoo' AND ds.enabled JOIN market_price_snapshots p ON p.data_source_id = ds.id AND p.security_id = s.id WHERE s.active_until IS NULL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN enabled.fred AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM macro_observation_snapshots m JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = m.data_source_id WHERE ds.code = 'fred') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS covered FROM enabled) SELECT round(100 * covered / NULLIF(expected, 0), 1)::double precision AS value FROM counts

panels.title: Latest snapshot coverage

panels.description: One row per configured active security. A missing snapshot remains visible instead of being dropped by an inner join.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(identifier.value, s.name) AS ticker, s.name, ds.enabled AS source_enabled, p.close_value::numeric AS close, p.currency, p.observed_at, p.available_at, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - p.available_at) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours_since_available, CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(ds.enabled, false) THEN 'source disabled' WHEN p.security_id IS NULL THEN 'no snapshot published' WHEN p.available_at < now() - interval '96 hours' THEN 'stale' ELSE 'current' END AS snapshot_state, ir.status::text AS run_status, p.schema_version, p.raw_payload_hash FROM securities s LEFT JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.code = 'yahoo' LEFT JOIN market_price_snapshots p ON p.data_source_id = ds.id AND p.security_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ingestion_runs ir ON ir.id = p.ingestion_run_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT si.value FROM security_identifiers si WHERE si.security_id = s.id AND si.identifier_type = 'ticker' AND si.valid_from <= now() AND (si.valid_until IS NULL OR si.valid_until > now()) ORDER BY si.is_primary DESC, si.valid_from DESC, si.value LIMIT 1) identifier ON true WHERE s.active_until IS NULL ORDER BY ticker

panels.title: Configured security latest prices

panels.description: Latest current-vintage FRED projections. If none have been published, the explicit no-snapshot row remains visible. Expected FRED series live only in YAML today, so this panel does not claim full configured-series coverage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(m.series_id, '(no snapshot published)') AS series_id, ds.enabled AS source_enabled, m.value::numeric AS value, m.unit, m.frequency, m.seasonal_adjustment, m.observed_at, m.available_at, m.vintage_at, m.revision, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - m.available_at) / 86400.0, 1) AS days_since_available, CASE WHEN NOT ds.enabled THEN 'source disabled' WHEN m.series_id IS NULL THEN 'no snapshot published' WHEN m.available_at < now() - interval '45 days' THEN 'stale' ELSE 'current' END AS snapshot_state, ir.status::text AS run_status, m.schema_version, m.raw_payload_hash FROM data_sources ds LEFT JOIN macro_observation_snapshots m ON m.data_source_id = ds.id LEFT JOIN ingestion_runs ir ON ir.id = m.ingestion_run_id WHERE ds.code = 'fred' ORDER BY m.series_id NULLS FIRST

panels.title: FRED latest observations

panels.description: Price and macro snapshot row counts distinguish successful ingestion from successful dashboard publication. SEC remains ingestion-only because migration 000002 defines no fundamental snapshot table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ds.code AS source, ds.enabled, max(ir.finished_at) FILTER (WHERE ir.status = 'succeeded') AS last_success, CASE ds.code WHEN 'yahoo' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM market_price_snapshots p WHERE p.data_source_id = ds.id) WHEN 'fred' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM macro_observation_snapshots m WHERE m.data_source_id = ds.id) ELSE NULL END AS snapshot_rows, CASE WHEN ds.code = 'sec' THEN 'ingestion only' WHEN ds.code IN ('yahoo', 'fred') AND CASE ds.code WHEN 'yahoo' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM market_price_snapshots p WHERE p.data_source_id = ds.id) ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM macro_observation_snapshots m WHERE m.data_source_id = ds.id) END THEN 'published' ELSE 'no snapshot published' END AS projection_state FROM data_sources ds LEFT JOIN ingestion_runs ir ON ir.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.code IN ('yahoo', 'sec', 'fred') GROUP BY ds.id, ds.code, ds.enabled ORDER BY ds.code
